name: Jai Herbert
event: UFC Fight Night: Allen vs. Duncan
summary: A tall, rangy English striker and former Cage Warriors lightweight champion, now 38; ten knockout wins. Beat Matheus Camilo by unanimous decision in October 2026 (29-28 x3) after a first-round KO of Mandel Nallo in April.

how_they_fight.Striking: Long, straight punching from range; reach about 196 cm, big for lightweight.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Defends takedowns well (about 78%) and is better off his back than his numbers suggest: against Camilo he gave up mount and his back, reversed to top and won the round with ground-and-pound.
how_they_fight.Defense: Decision losses when out-worked (Chris Padilla, Fares Ziam).
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Steady three-round pace; at 38 still out-worked a 25-year-old in round 3 behind the jab and leg kicks.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Experienced; must keep a wrestler at range.

concerns: Gets taken down by strong clinch wrestlers (twice by Camilo), though he scrambles back
